title: Resharding with fixed slots: move one slot at a time, then flip the map
caption: Keys map to many fixed slots (say 1024), and slots map to shards. Only whole slots move, and the app never notices.

messages.label: snapshot slot 37 → B
messages.note: Pick a slot on the overloaded shard. Copy its rows to the new shard while A keeps serving reads and writes.

messages.label: stream changes since snapshot
messages.note: Writes that hit slot 37 during the copy are replayed from A's change log until B is only milliseconds behind.

messages.label: pause writes to slot 37
messages.note: A short freeze (milliseconds to a second) on just this slot, so the last changes can drain.

messages.label: slot 37 → B
messages.note: Flip one entry in the map. Routers pick it up and send slot 37 traffic to B.

messages.label: delete slot 37 rows
messages.note: Clean up the old copy later. Repeat slot by slot until the load is even.
